accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Apply a chart template or add the first account.
accounts.lockedHint: Cannot be changed after the account is created.
accounts.parentHint: Only active accounts of the same type are offered.
accounts.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate account {{number}} - {{name}}? It takes no new postings; its history stays in the books.

mapping.unmappedOnReport: For the cash-flow statements the movements no row takes are listed on the report itself; for the notes, map a prefix to the table it belongs to.
mapping.hint: Place the accounts of your own chart on the rows of B01 / B02. A prefix counts every account whose number starts with it. The standard layout's own placement cannot be changed here.
mapping.unmapped: Accounts with postings that no row takes
mapping.noneUnmapped: Every account with postings is on a row.
mapping.failed: The mapping could not be saved.

loans.dayCountHint: Actual/365 and actual/360 count the interest of each day on the outstanding principal and need an interest rate; the interest paid then defaults to the interest of the days to the repayment.
loans.autoAccrueOn: Automatic month-end accrual: on (Fiscal periods → closing policy)
loans.autoAccrueOff: Automatic month-end accrual: off (switch it on in Fiscal periods → closing policy)
loans.postDrawdown: Post the drawdown to the books (Dr Bank / Cr Loan payable); repayments are then posted with their interest. Untick for a loan already booked by hand.
loans.title: Loans
loans.hint: Borrowings with their repayment schedule. The balance sheet shows the part due after 12 months as long-term. Drawing and repaying the money is still booked as a journal entry; the ledger here gives B01 the real due dates.
loans.schedule: Repayment schedule (principal due on each date)
loans.failed: The loan could not be saved.

offBalance.title: Off-balance Register
offBalance.hint: Accounts 001 – 008 (leased assets, goods held for others, foreign currency …) have no double entry: record each movement here. They are not part of the balance sheet.
offBalance.failed: The off-balance entry could not be saved.

fiscalPeriods.empty: No fiscal periods yet. Open the first one to start posting.
fiscalPeriods.endBeforeStart: The end date must not be before the start date.
fiscalPeriods.title: Fiscal Periods
fiscalPeriods.closeConfirm: Close period "{{periodName}}"? The period-end transfer (revenue and expenses to the result account) is posted and the period is locked. It can be reopened later.
fiscalPeriods.reopenHint: Reopen "{{periodName}}"? Its closing entry is voided and posting is allowed again; close the period once the corrections are made.
fiscalPeriods.policyYearEnd: Year end (one closing entry a year)
fiscalPeriods.policyMonthlyHint: Closing a period writes its own closing entry (revenue and expenses to the result account).
fiscalPeriods.autoAccrue: Accrue loan interest automatically at month end
fiscalPeriods.autoAccrueHint: From the 1st of each month the interest of the posted loans is accrued to the last day of the previous month (Dr interest expense / Cr interest payable); a closed period is skipped.
fiscalPeriods.policyYearEndHint: Closing a period only locks it; the last period of the fiscal year writes one closing entry for everything not yet closed. Change the mode only between fiscal years.

fx.noRate: No rate is entered for this currency in the master data: type it.
fx.paymentRatePrompt: Rate the {{currency}} was paid at (base currency per 1 {{currency}}):
fx.revaluationHint: Revalues the open foreign receivables and payables at the closing rates of the period. The entry is dated the last day and reversed the next day.

bankRecon.noLines: No lines yet: upload the bank's CSV.
bankRecon.outstandingTitle: Ledger lines the bank has not shown

vat.issueConfirm: Issue the e-invoice of {{number}} with these buyer details? It is sent to the e-invoice provider and the invoice's VAT is locked.
vat.replaceConfirm: Issue a replacement e-invoice? The one in force is cancelled and the replacement takes its place.
vat.adjustConfirm: Issue an adjustment e-invoice (net {{net}}, VAT {{tax}})? An issued adjustment cannot be withdrawn.
vat.useLines: Several VAT lines (rates / goods not subject to VAT)
vat.adjustHint: Invoice amount {{amount}}: the amount owed does not change, only its split into net and VAT.
vat.approvePrompt: VAT rate (%) on the supplier's invoice (the split made when the bill was created is kept if you leave it)
vat.gapsMessage: {{count}} document(s) have no journal entry (no open fiscal period or an incomplete posting profile).
vat.settlementTitle: Settle the VAT of a period

reports.title: Accounting Reports
reports.notesYear: Fiscal year of the texts (0 = every year)
reports.notesHistoryEmpty: No change has been recorded for this text yet.
reports.notesNoPdf: PDF is not available in this language yet (no CJK font); use Excel or CSV.
reports.notesEdit: Edit the texts of the notes (policies, standards …)

reports.draftWarning: draft layout: the accountant must review it before filing
reports.unmappedTitle: Accounts with a balance that this statement does not take
reports.noCashAccounts: No account is marked as a cash account. Mark cash and bank accounts in the chart of accounts.
reports.cashFlowNote: Direct method: each cash movement is classified by the account on the other side of the entry (set per account in the chart of accounts). Transfers between cash and bank accounts are not shown. Not an official B03 form.
reports.selectDateRange: Select a from/to date range to run the report.

journalEntries.postsNow: The entry is posted to the ledger as soon as you press Post; there is no draft. Fix a mistake afterwards by reversing or voiding it.
journalEntries.title: Journal Entries
journalEntries.reverseHint: Posts a mirror entry; the original stays in the books as Reversed.
journalEntries.voidHint: Takes a hand-written entry of an open period out of the books. Entries that belong to a document are reversed instead.
journalEntries.notBalanced: Not balanced — total debit must equal total credit
journalEntries.failedToSave: Failed to post journal entry. Please try again.

products.title: Import products
products.columns: Required: sku, name. Optional: description, productType (Physical, Digital, Service, Bundle), categoryCode, brandCode, price, discountedPrice, cost, barcode, weightKg, status (Draft or Active).

employees.title: Import employees
employees.columns: Required: firstName, lastName, departmentCode, dateOfHire (yyyy-MM-dd or dd/MM/yyyy). Optional: employeeNumber (generated when blank), email, phone, positionCode, employmentType (FullTime, PartTime, Contract). No login is created.
employees.pageIntro: Add many employees at once from a CSV file. Employees are stored in master data; HR sees them a moment after the import.

mfg.noPlant: Create a plant first: every Manufacturing screen works inside a plant.
mfg.deactivateInstead: If it is in use, deactivate it instead.

issue.issueHint: Name the material and the quantity. Lots are typed or scanned; "Suggest lots" fills first-expiry-first lots.
issue.returnHint: Return unused material to the warehouse. Lot-controlled items need the lot they were issued from.
issue.lotHint: Type or scan the lot number
issue.unknownLot: Lot "{{lot}}" is not known for this item.
issue.reservedCovers: the order's reservation covers it ({{qty}} reserved)
issue.noLines: No lines yet. Add a line to start.
issue.overReasonHint: The quantity is above the allowed tolerance. It needs a reason and the permission to over-issue.

plants.hint: A plant owns its warehouses, calendars, work centers, BOMs and routings. Warehouses must exist and be active.
plants.defaultCalendarHint: Create the calendar in "Shifts and calendars", then choose it here.
plants.emptyHint: Add the first plant to start.
plants.accessHint: Holders of the settings permission see every plant; other users see only the plants listed here.
plants.noAccess: No user was granted this plant.

settings.hint: Parameters of the plant. A change applies to transactions after it is saved and is kept in the audit trail.
settings.readOnly: You can read these parameters but not change them.
settings.overProductionTolerancePctHint: Receipt ceiling above the ordered quantity
settings.underCompletionTolerancePctHint: Below this an order needs a reason to close
settings.blockReleaseOnShortage: Block release when material is short
settings.autoCompleteOnFullReceipt: Complete the order on full receipt
settings.costingHint: Cannot change while orders are open

profiles.title: Item profile
profiles.hint: How each item is planned in this plant: made or bought, lead times, lot sizing, safety stock. The low-level code is computed by the system.
profiles.defaults: No profile was saved yet; these are the defaults of a made item.
profiles.fqcHint: The inspection plan is linked when quality plans arrive in a later phase.

calendars.hint: Shifts say when work happens; a calendar says which shifts work on which weekday, plus holidays and special days.
calendars.overnightHint: An end not after the start is an overnight shift
calendars.breakHint: Unpaid, taken at the end of the shift
calendars.noneHint: Create shifts first, then a calendar.
calendars.monthHint: Each cell: day of month, working minutes. Exceptions are named.

wc.hint: Where work is done. Capacity per day = working minutes x resources x efficiency x utilization.
wc.capacityTotal: Total capacity in the range: {{minutes}} standard minutes
wc.capacityFailed: The capacity could not be read.

catalogs.hint: Machines of the work centers, standard operations to copy into routings, reasons for scrap, rework, downtime ..., and crews.
catalogs.idealCycleHint: Must be above 0; used for OEE

bom.hint: What one base quantity of an item is made of. A change to an approved BOM is a new version.
bom.approveAsk: Approve {{code}} version {{version}}? An approved version can no longer be edited, and the version before it ends the day before it starts.
bom.obsoleteAsk: Make {{code}} version {{version}} obsolete? Existing orders keep their copy.
bom.copyAsk: Copy {{code}} version {{version}} into a new draft?
bom.immutable: This version is approved: it cannot be edited. Copy it to make a change.
bom.altHint: Lines of one group replace each other; priority 1 is used
bom.costShareHint: The co-products together must stay below 100%
bom.noOtherVersion: There is no other version to compare with.
bom.whereUsedHint: Which BOMs use an item, level by level.
bom.whereUsedPick: Choose an item to see where it is used.
bom.whereUsedNone: No approved BOM uses this item.

routing.hint: The operations that make an item, in order, with the work center and times of each.
routing.empty: No routing yet. An item may have none.
routing.dragHint: Drag a row to change the order (or use the arrows); the operations are renumbered 10, 20, 30 ...
routing.fromStandardHint: Its values are copied; later changes to the standard operation do not change this routing.
routing.approveAsk: Approve {{code}} version {{version}}? It can no longer be edited.
routing.copyAsk: Copy {{code}} version {{version}} into a new draft?
routing.warningsTitle: Approved, but some BOM lines name an operation this routing does not have
routing.endDateHint: The schedule is counted backwards from here
routing.leadFailed: The lead time could not be calculated.

import.bomTitle: Import a BOM from a CSV file
import.routingTitle: Import a routing from a CSV file
import.hint: Every line is checked first. Nothing is saved while the file has an error; a clean file becomes a new draft version. Use CSV UTF-8.
import.templateFailed: The template could not be downloaded.
import.cleanDry: The file is clean ({{count}} lines). Press Import to create the draft.
import.errorsHint: Fix the lines below in your file and check again. Nothing was saved.

plan.hint: What is checked, how many units are taken and how many minor defects are tolerated. A plan is a series (code) in versions; only an approved version is used.
plan.codeHint: Names the series of versions (2-20 characters A-Z, 0-9, '-').
plan.allowedMinorHint: A lot passes when no critical characteristic fails and at most this many other characteristics fail.
plan.rangeHint: Leave a bound empty when it does not limit. The minimum cannot be above the maximum.
plan.immutable: An approved or obsolete plan cannot be changed. Copy it to make a new version.
plan.approveAsk: Approve plan {{code}} version {{version}}? From then on it cannot be changed and is used for new inspections.
plan.obsoleteAsk: Make plan {{code}} version {{version}} obsolete? New receipts and reports are no longer inspected by it.
plan.copyAsk: Create a new draft version of plan {{code}}?
plan.deleteAsk: Delete the draft of plan {{code}} version {{version}}?

insp.hint: The inspections waiting for a result: one per received lot on hold (final) and one per Good report of an operation with a plan (in process).
insp.submitFqc: Submit {{doc}}? If it passes, the lot moves to the finished-goods warehouse and becomes available. The result cannot be changed afterwards.
insp.submitIpqc: Submit {{doc}}? If it passes, the quantity can be taken by the next operation. The result cannot be changed afterwards.
insp.failedStays: The lot stays on hold (or the output stays out of the next operation) until it is re-inspected or handled.
insp.passedFqc: Passed: the lot was released to the finished-goods warehouse.
insp.passedIpqc: Passed: {{qty}} can be taken by the next operation.
insp.cancelled: Cancelled: the receipt or report it inspected was reversed.
insp.noRight: You can read this inspection but not enter results.
insp.noInspection: No inspection plan: release by hand
insp.openCount: {{count}} inspections still decide something (waiting for a result, or failed).

profile.fqcPlanHint: Approved FQC plans of this item. The version in force on the day of the receipt is used.
profile.noPlanWarning: No plan is linked: lots of this item are received on hold with no inspection document and are released by hand.

routing.ipqcPlanHint: Each Good report of this operation gets an inspection; the next operation can take only what passed.

rev.reportMessage: The report {{doc}} of operation {{seq}} (good {{good}}, scrap {{scrap}}, rework {{rework}}) is taken off the operation and the order, and the material it consumed is returned to the Warehouse. A counter-report is created; the original stays in the list. It cannot be reversed if the next operation or a receipt already used its output.
rev.receiptMessage: The receipt {{doc}} ({{lines}}) is taken out of the Warehouse again, what its backflush consumed is returned, and the completed quantity of the order goes down; a completed order below its threshold is reopened. It cannot be reversed if a lot was released from quality hold or used.
rev.pending: Saved and waiting: the Warehouse will be told again; the order shows the effect when it is booked.

reasonDialog.none: There is no active reason of type "{{type}}". Add one in

order.hint: Production orders of the plant: create, release, follow and close them. Material and finished goods go through stock documents that the Warehouse confirms.
order.loadFailed: The orders could not be loaded.
order.notFound: This order could not be found.
order.reservationPending: Saved. The Warehouse reservation is being brought in line and will follow shortly.
order.unreleaseMessage: Order {{no}} returns to Draft and its reservation is released. This works only before any material or output was booked.
order.resumeMessage: Order {{no}} goes back to the status it had before the hold.
order.reopenMessage: Order {{no}} goes back to In progress.
order.cancelMessage: A cancelled order is final and its reservation is released. Choose why.
order.holdMessage: Work on the order stops until it is resumed. Choose why.
order.shortCloseMessage: Only {{done}} of {{planned}} were received. Completing below the tolerance needs a reason.
order.quantityHint: The new quantity cannot be below what is completed ({{done}}). Required material, operation times, schedule and reservation follow.
order.pendingDocs: {{count}} stock document(s) are being sent to the Warehouse. This page refreshes by itself.
order.syncPending: The Warehouse reservation of this order is being updated.
order.syncError: The reservation could not be updated yet: {{error}}
order.hasShortage: Some materials cannot be covered by the stock available now.
order.noShortage: Every material is covered by the stock available now.

form.versionHint: Leave empty to use the version valid on the start date.

bulk.max: At most {{max}} orders can be released at once.
bulk.failed: The order could not be released.

doc.pendingHint: Not yet in the Warehouse (attempt {{attempts}}). It is sent again automatically.
doc.abandonMessage: Whatever {{doc}} already booked in the Warehouse is reversed and the document ends Failed. Continue?
doc.retryFailed: The action could not be completed.
doc.qcReleaseMessage: The held lots of {{doc}} move to the finished-goods warehouse and become available. This stands in for the final inspection until it is built.
doc.acceptedPending: Document {{doc}} is saved and waits for the Warehouse; it is sent again automatically.
doc.pageHint: Documents waiting for the Warehouse or refused by it need a person; open the order for details.

opx.endAfterStart: The end must be after the start.
opx.reportHint: Reported so far: good {{good}}, scrap {{scrap}}, rework {{rework}}.
opx.reportPending: Report {{doc}} is saved and counts as soon as its material booking reaches the Warehouse.
opx.completeMessage: Operation {{seq}} {{name}} is completed by hand and its open time logs are closed.
opx.reopenMessage: Operation {{seq}} {{name}} becomes Ready again. This works only while the next operation has no work.
